text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B., a girl who follows only her own heart.
I came to witness that strength firsthand, but—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that was some crazy heavy rain~!
Is it gonna pour again?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it, track condition is definitely heavy!
Isn't that terrible? Especially for, you know, closers—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Arriving without an umbrella, I see.
How is your condition, C.B.?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mm, perfect.
...Wait, were you waiting for me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Knowing you, I figured you would need this.
Here is a towel. Use it in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha, read me like an open book, huh.
Thanks, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it.
Everyone has their own way of preparing their condition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Flawless and unbound.
Show me your running.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Mr. C.B. was soaked to the bone, wasn't she?
Did she run all the way here?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she's getting desperate?
Bad weather is brutal on closers, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(Rain isn't so bad!
The drops hitting my cheeks, the mud splattering...)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(Trying to close the gap after heavy turf drains your stamina is reckless.
Sure, that might be true, right?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(Things might not go the usual way.
...Yeah, I guess that's true too?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not convinced.
—"I" will never bow to that.

The race got underway.
Turf flying everywhere, vision blurred—
The race in the rain was turning out as wildly tumultuous as predicted.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, everyone's out of breath and staggering...!
Looks like the front-runner's gonna run away with the win...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wait... h-hey, look behind them!
Is that—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Surging up from the rear, it's Mr. C.B.!
C.B. has leaped into the lead!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I see it... straight ahead, my path!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
No way, overtaking everyone in one go in these conditions...?! 
How stunningly brilliant...!
(*WAAAAAAAHHH!!*)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Mhm, what a wonderful sight.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Not following where someone else points.
Following wherever my inner compass leads—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Looks like today, it was right here.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, incredible... what monstrous strength!
Such a free-spirited run, I'm completely moved!!

A horse girl who is completely free, and at the same time,
has no choice but to keep walking her own solitary path.

Witnessing her unshakeable strength firsthand,
I felt a renewed surge of motivation rising within me.
